name: source_row
description: Line number of the record in the raw release file (header = line 1)

name: record_id
description: Stable per-source record id (AEA GlobalID); key for corrections and release diffs

name: object_id
description: Row id in the publisher's map service

name: ast_facility_id
description: AEA facility id (present on ~60% of rows); the harness facility_id

name: aea_id
description: AEA facility number

name: uscg_id
description: US Coast Guard id

name: tank_farm_id
description: AEA tank-farm id; drives the shared-farm-id detector

name: tank_farm_evaluation_id
description: AEA tank-farm assessment id

name: community_id
description: DCRA community GUID; matches City_Boundaries.CommunityI

name: community_name
description: Community label as published (corrected by corrections.csv; normalised by aliases.csv)

name: entity_name
description: Facility / organisation name (kept by owner decision 2026-10-06)

name: street_address
description: Facility street address (kept by owner decision 2026-10-06)

name: postal_code
description: Facility ZIP code

name: latitude
description: Position used by both pipelines (EPSG:4326)

name: longitude
description: Position used by both pipelines (EPSG:4326)

name: map_x
description: Publisher map point easting (EPSG:3338); AEA's 2025 fixes changed only this

name: map_y
description: Publisher map point northing (EPSG:3338)

name: delivery_method
description: Delivery mode(s): Road / Barge / Plane / "Plane or Barge" / "Plane or Road"

name: total_capacity
description: Tank-farm or facility total capacity

name: source
description: Originating program: AEA / DEC / USCG

name: report
description: Assessment or report name

name: last_edited
description: Publisher edit timestamp; shows which records changed between releases
